name: 004-reducer-core
description: The reducer's own machinery, at a size a human can read. Pins four things 001 and 002 leave implicit: an event carrying an explicit payload schema version, which the engine must accept only while it still implements that version; dispatch alternating between two registered modules; a module slice accumulating across events, which is how issues #5 through #13 will hold their state; and the transcript's index and timestamp discipline, where an event is stamped at the instant it was issued rather than the one it finished at — the last clock.tick advances a full day and is still recorded at the moment before it.
